## Screener: Classify Transcript
Input: transcript (+ contact_name). Output: call_outcome, owner_reached, confidence, evidence_quote, quote_verified, owner_name.
The AI owns who-answered only; busy/quiet is the screener's mark (spec §4). Strict JSON schema, temperature 0. Called by Screener: Capture Call and by the Classifier Eval harness.
